newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HITZFELD QUITS AS COACH OF EURO CUP WINNERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HITZFELD QUITS AS COACH OF EURO CUP WINNERS.

text.p: Ottmar Hitzfeld announced he was stepping down as coach of Borussia Dortmund on Friday, just over a week after the club won the European Cup.
Hitzfeld told a news conference that he would be taking over as sports director at the club. It is not yet known who will take his place as trainer.
Earlier this week, Hitzfeld hinted at management problems at the club after chairman Gerd Niebaum announced he was stepping down.
Hitzfeld has been in charge since 1991 and last week led Dortmund to the biggest moment in their history with a 3-1 victory over Juventus in the European Cup final in Munich.
He also steered the club to German league titles in 1995 and 1996.
